verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own product page documents granular branch-level permissions and standardized, customizable merge checks that enforce code quality and CI/CD policies across repositories, which covers the core of protecting branches and gating merges. These are marketing-level claims only and do not spell out the specific rules in the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of required reviewer approvals, explicit requirement of passing builds/checks before merge, git tag protection (the 'tags' mentioned refer to package/container tags), in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
